title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-5a2y: TH_2 test vectors stale after CBOR encoding fix
description:
The recent fix (260dfcd) changed transcript_2() in edhoc.rs and edhoc.py to use CBOR bstr encoding instead of raw concatenation per RFC 9528 Section 3.2. However, the hardcoded test vector at edhoc.rs:1542 was computed using the OLD raw-concat method and is now wrong.

Old (raw concat): c1d8c6ee4eeb1672d7fcbb44f8d811419739b79b852fce03f527eacdaf6633c4
Correct (CBOR bstr): c6405c154c567466ab1df20369500e540e9f14bd3a796a0652cae66c9061688d

All downstream test vectors at lines 1544-1590 (prk_2e, keystream_2, th_3, th_4, prk_out, prk_exporter, export_context) must also be recomputed since they depend on the corrected TH_2 value.

Additionally, the edhoc module currently has 84 compilation errors when built with --features edhoc (pre-existing from earlier restructuring), so the test cannot run to verify the fix. This is a separate issue.
